applies_why: The judge text addresses whether the Isaiah 7:14 challenge was answered, which K-G4 governs by excluding answered verses from being counted as unanswered witnesses.
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge expressly says the challenge was answered in named rounds, so under K-G4 the verse is not counted as an unanswered witness and no quote of a pressing sentence is required.
